# BUILD_INFO.h is generated (create_build_info.sh in CI) and not tracked, so no
# hand edit can reach a release. A local build without one gets a WIP version.
if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/BUILD_INFO.h")
    file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/BUILD_INFO.h"
        "// generated by main/CMakeLists.txt for a local build\n"
        "#ifndef BUILD_INFO_H\n#define BUILD_INFO_H\n#define FW_VERSION \"KIBBL-AIR-WIP\"\n#endif\n")
endif()

# WHOLE_ARCHIVE: kibbl_core calls the product hooks (KL_product.c), which nothing in
# main calls itself, so the linker would drop them otherwise
idf_component_register(SRC_DIRS "."
                    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
                    WHOLE_ARCHIVE)

target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE "-Wformat" "-Wno-format-zero-length" "-Wextra" "-Wno-unused-parameter")
